notes.title: Flibbius McDoogle is going on a new adventure!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We are super excited to announce that we have officially begun working on a new instalment of Flibbius McDoogle. Say hello to Flibbius McDoogle and the Temple of the Toad King! A group of adventurers have gone missing and it’s up to Flibbius McDoogle to find them!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3896500/Flibbius_McDoogle_and_the_Temple_of_the_Toad_King"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We were really happy with how the first game was received (thanks to you!!) and so many said they would want to play more, go on other adventures or could imagine the game being a series so we got to thinking... and we think you are right! [/p][p][/p][p]So we're taking Flibbius on a bigger adventure this time filled with underwater exploration, tree-top zip lining and grappling gun shooting. (All made of his own brilliant inventions of course!) The steam page is a bit bare bones right now but we can't wait to share more with you and are aiming at having a demo out later this year. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289320/02740c9824152a9b9cb0a67eb911db89265e6b49.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289320/35f3805906abeb4339056bca5bba138772d43bd1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll join us as we delve in to the jungle, dive underwater depths and explore the Temple of the Toad King to find the missing adventurers! If you want to see more progress updates please follow us on TikTok, BlueSky or join our discord :) [/p][p][/p][p]See you soon! [/p][p]Romy & Lasse [/p]

notes.title: Some wins and thank you's from a successful launch week!
notes.notes:
It's been just over a week since Flibbius launched and we are so happy with the response! Thank you to everyone who has supported this silly little game. It makes me really happy that we already have 27 100% positive reviews! Not only are they helpful for other players and a boost for the games visibility, we also read every single one and are really grateful for the feedback so we know where to improve next time. 

[b]Here is a little round up of some wins from our launch week:[/b]

1. This amazing review by So Many Games: https://somanygames.co.uk/review/flibbius-mcdoogle/
Thank you Kurosh Jozavi! 

2. The response we got from the Cozy Gamers fb group: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/15TkjnN1yY/
Honestly this completely blew us away! Thank you to everyone there that messaged us and played the game and helped share it! You are amazing.  

3. Hearing Penge's final thoughts at the end of his playthrough video: https://youtu.be/UPlF5Yvy4cs?feature=shared
Thank you for playing, we're so happy you enjoyed it this much!

4. Hitting the 10 review mark and getting this wonderful bump in visibility from the Discovery Queue

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289320/3a3a14054504ddece19c7f3bfa91e718ad020962.png[/img]


5. All the love from the steam deck community on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/SteamDeck/comments/1kcv5mb/my_lovely_wife_and_i_made_a_cozy_adventure_puzzle/
Happy to report the game plays very well on Steam Deck! Thank you to everyone who came back and gave us feedback.

6. Every streamer who responded to our many emails and played the game. You're the best! We have checked out all your streams (we do a little Flibbius google every day like nerds to check for new ones) and appreciate you taking the time to play it and share it with your community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289320/3988de7e708e52e883515158560df62fa37f92a7.png[/img]


Many people have been asking me if we plan to take the game to other platforms or if we plan on doing a sequel and the answer is that we would LOVE to do both those things but it depends on whether or not there would be a demand for it. 

We're keeping our fingers crossed that the game grows in popularity and we can think about doing a second Flibbius adventure!

notes.title: We Have a New Release Date! And a little demo update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We had initially planned to release on the 21st but have had to push the release date (by just one short week) to the 28th April 2025! Apologies for the delay. 

We also pushed a small patch to our demo a couple of days ago. It included some bug fixes, a new main menu and some new interactables we've been working on (P.S. you can now ring the bell at Flib's house and do some other silly things around the island)

Thank you to everyone who played our demo, wishlisted or shared our game. It makes such a difference and we really appreciate you. 

If you are a content creator and would like to cover Flibbius you are welcome to reach out to me on BlueSky ( @niminy.bsky.social ) and request a key or by emailing me: romy@unsigneddouble.com 

We are SO excited to share our game with you 🥳 Have a wonderful day!
